key.name: toggle-hid
key.summary: Engage the keyboard and touchpad lock
key.description: Shortcut that engages the lock. It does not release it: once the lock is on, the daemon holds an exclusive grab and the shell never sees the keyboard at all, so no shell keybinding can fire. The daemon watches its own grabbed stream for Ctrl+Esc and releases on that. Ctrl+Esc is fixed and not configurable, deliberately -- it is the escape hatch, and a rebindable escape hatch can be rebound into a lockout.
